purpose: Freeze the successor native A/B/C cycle-block benchmark before observing new native timing data.

fail_closed_if_unresolved: dirty spectralDNS worktree affecting solver code
frozen numerical tolerances cannot be resolved from canonical evidence

arms.C: guarded forced-fallback control on the same physical trajectory; sparse execution disabled while wrapper/guard/fallback machinery is preserved

sampling.order_algorithm: For cycle c=1..23 sort the six literal orders by lowercase SHA256(seed_material+'|cycle='+c+'|order='+order), ascending. Data-independent.

before_each_cycle: start a fresh solver worker process
reconstruct solver/context from frozen canonical input
verify pinned runtime and numerical settings
record cycle timestamp, worker identity, host-load metadata, compilation/cache reuse
between_cycles: carry no solver arrays, route state, sparse caches, RNG state or mutable app context
reuse immutable binaries/JIT artifacts only symmetrically across A/B/C and log reuse
cycle_boundary_protocol.exact_binomial_interpretation_requires: Post-run justification of independent cycle block bits under the null, or a separately predeclared calibrated dependence law.
cycle_boundary_protocol.fail_closed_rule: Without that justification/calibration, block-sign p-values are DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY and no confirmatory performance acceptance is allowed.

ties_and_effect.cycle_success_rule: block success iff >=4 of 6 triplet contrasts are strictly positive
ties_and_effect.tie_rule: No deletion, replacement, resampling or conditioning on ties

statistics.global_target: AB directional advantage AND CB directional advantage
statistics.method: intersection-union test over two one-sided cycle-block sign components
statistics.within_cycle_null_condition: Central sign symmetry of the complete six-dimensional gate-difference vector => cycle success probability <=1/2 despite arbitrary within-cycle dependence.
statistics.cross_cycle_condition: Independent cycles, or explicit predeclared dependence calibration.

negative_control.observer: AC block success iff >=4/6 AC triplet contrasts >0

correctness_gates.numerical_tolerance_source: Resolve frozen numerical tolerances from canonical immutable evidence before first timed triplet; unresolved => no acceptance evaluation.
required_diagnostics: per-stage max|K·Source_hat| where Source is present
correctness_gates.longitudinal_source_negative_control: Diagnostic only; not pooled into confirmatory timing blocks.

timing_and_cost_accounting.shadow_counterfactual_rule: Retain numerical shadow dense work for sparse-eligible calls outside production timing.
timing_and_cost_accounting.cycle_reset_cost_rule: Log reset/process-launch/compilation/cache behavior; charge arm-specific setup/allocation/compilation to that arm; report common design-reset overhead separately and symmetrically.
timing_and_cost_accounting.horizon_gate: Fully charged 138-triplet arm totals must satisfy A_horizon_total_ms>B_horizon_total_ms and C_horizon_total_ms>B_horizon_total_ms.

acceptance_logic: Fail confirmatory interpretation if cross-cycle independence or a predeclared replacement dependence calibration is not justified.
Fail if any B triplet has zero sparse calls or any C triplet has nonzero sparse calls.
For AB and CB, derive 23 block bits using >=4/6 strict positives; require >=16 successes for each.
Global IUT passes only if both AB and CB pass; no AB/CB cross-gate independence is required.
Derive AC block bits by same >=4/6 rule; >=16 AC positives veto sparse-speed attribution until explained.
Require fully charged 138-triplet horizon totals A>B and C>B.
Retain every raw triplet magnitude/order/timestamp and all correctness/cost fields.
epsilon=0 block passage does not establish a material speedup magnitude.
Even all-gate passage is only a native checkpoint pending independent review, not generic CFD/industrial acceleration or a continuous-PDE theorem.
boundary: Successor-manifest freeze only; does not certify cross-cycle independence, execute native spectralDNS/shenfun/MPI/FFTW, claim speedup, or grant final acceptance.
